mit.connection_note: Only the shared connection held on portal04 is used (rule uva-login-nodes-services-and-outside-connections.md). ProxyCommand=false and ControlMaster=no make a command fail on portal04 when that connection is closed, instead of trying a new login (MIT shuts out an address after failed logins); every call checks the connection with ssh -O check first. Opening it again needs the user (Duo push or the web login).
